# Retail CoD 1.5b cod_lnxded under gdb, mp_carentan, gametype probe_testclient (two addTestClient bots), 2026-11-14.
#   COD_VERSION=1.5 COD_LNXDED=<a wrapper running gdb -batch -x <script> --args <server>> PORT=29000 SECS=40 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh probe_testclient mp_carentan   (inside unshare -rn)
# The gdb script, one breakpoint on the bot pass's stamp bump and one on the bot think's SV_ClientThink call:
#   set pagination off
#   set confirm off
#   handle SIGPIPE nostop noprint
#   set $n = 0
#   break *0x8094221
#   commands
#   silent
#   printf "BUMP stamp=%d\n", *(int*)0x835f4a4
#   continue
#   end
#   break *0x8094214
#   commands
#   silent
#   set $n = $n + 1
#   printf "THINK client=%d stamp=%d\n", (*(int*)($ebp+8) - *(int*)0x83ccd90) / 0x5a9b4, *(int*)0x835f4a4
#   if $n >= 40
#     kill
#     quit
#   end
#   continue
#   end
#   run
